{{Quote|<s></s>''Personal enjoyment'' isn't reason enough? What you Jedi don't understand is that your wars are ''pointless.'' And the longer they drag out&mdash;the longer ''I'' can drag them out&mdash;the ''richer'' I get. So why not have some fun, too?|Attuma Duum explaining the rationale behind the battle to Aayla Secura|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju">''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''</ref>}}
This '''battle''' near the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Cavamina Minor]] took place around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] against the backdrop of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Prelude==
The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] was assigned to arrest the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Attuma Duum]]. Her [[Skirmish in the Cavamina Minor cantina|mission failed]], and she fled Duum's men, arriving into the hands of the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Shon-Ju]] and his [[Shon-Ju's Force school|students]]. Secura and Shon-Ju agreed to join forces to stop Duum. Duum, for his part, was playing both sides of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against each other, and planted false evidence to draw a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to his system.

==The ambush==
{{Expandsect}}
{{Quote|We have them! Keep pushing&mdash;keep driving them down!|The Skakoan commander|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju" />}}
Duum seeded the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] around the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Cavamina Minor]] with six hundred thousand [[Space mine/Legends|space mines]], and the Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator Star Destroyers]], [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]], and [[CR20 troop carrier/Legends|CR-20 troop carriers]] reverted from hyperspace right into the mine field. The Separatist fleet
s [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Munificent-class star frigates]], [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|battleships]], and [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] also experienced the same problem. Seeing an opposing fleet instead of the merchant convoy Duum had promised them, both fleet commanders ordered their crews to open fire on the other.

Secura and Shon-Ju infiltrated [[Attuma Duum's headquarters]] and managed to disable the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] protecting the station from the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field. As the station died, Shon-Ju betrayed Secura, inadvertently allowing Duum to escape. The Republic fleet withdrew after taking heavy casualties, including the cruiser [[Vagabond (starship)|''Vagabond'']].

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Yes, tragic the events were&mdash;but a failure your mission was not. Destroyed was Duum's operation. And sense a change in ''you'' I do, Aayla Secura.''"<br />"''Yes...maybe. Perhaps I found something within myself that was ''missing'' before.|Yoda and Secura after her mission to Cavamina Minor|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju" />}}
Secura and the Republic fleet returned to Coruscant; she later met with [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. Shon-Ju received prosthetic hands, replacing those he lost to Secura. Duum survived the battle.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle appears in the [[2010]] graphic novella ''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''.
